action.option: Escalate 2010 for annual mortality peak follow-up

brief_basis: The chart's y-axis is inverted (0 at top, 8 at bottom), so a higher mortality rate corresponds to a point lower on the plot. The 2010 point is the lowest on the plot (closest to 8), indicating the peak mortality rate among the years shown. Therefore 2010 warrants peak-burden escalation.
